situation: Just joined a running club's WhatsApp group, about 40 people. I'm slow and training for my first half marathon in March. Want to say hi.
reply: Hi all, I'm Tessa, just joined after lurking at the Saturday parkrun for a month. I'm training for my first half, Brighton in March, and I'm firmly at the back at about 6:40 per km. Off the track I teach Year 5, so I'm good at herding and bad at hills. Anyone else doing Brighton, or up for a slow Sunday long run?
note: Stating the pace up front invites the right people to reply.

situation: I'm taking over an account from a colleague who left. Need to introduce myself by email to the client's marketing team.
reply: Hi all, I'm Rohan, and I'm taking over as your account manager from Beth, who left on Friday. I've spent four years running paid search for retail brands, and I've read every campaign note Beth left, so nothing resets. Outside work I'm usually on a cricket pitch in Leyton on Sundays. Could we do 30 minutes next week so you can tell me what's working and what isn't? Tuesday or Thursday afternoon both suit me.
note: For a handover, the reassurance that nothing resets is the one thing they most need to hear.

situation: New PhD student, have to introduce myself at the lab's first group meeting. About 30 seconds, spoken.
reply: Hi, I'm Kwame, first-year PhD with Professor Lindqvist. I did my master's in Accra on soil microbes under drought, and I'm here to take that into root imaging. I'm also new to Uppsala and have never owned a winter coat, so advice on that is very welcome. And whoever runs the confocal bookings, I'd love ten minutes with you.
note: The coat line is the hook people will actually use to start a conversation.

situation: 孩子刚转学到三年级二班，被拉进了家长群，两百多人。想发个自我介绍，不想太长也不想像打广告。
reply: 各位家长好，我是新转来的周子航的妈妈刘婧。我们上个月刚从成都搬到杭州，住在学校东边的翠苑小区。我在医院做药剂师，孩子用药方面有拿不准的可以问我。子航特别爱踢球，周末要是有小朋友在小区踢，欢迎叫上他！
note: 家长群里先说清是谁的家长，给一个真能帮上忙的点，再留一个让人容易接话的邀请。

situation: I start Monday as engineering manager for a payments team of 7. Their last manager left suddenly and one of them applied for my job. I want to post a short hello in the team Slack channel on day one.
reply: Hi all, I'm Nadia, and from today I'm managing the payments team. I spent the last five years leading the checkout team at Brightline, so I know how much of this work is invisible until it breaks. Outside work I'm usually at the climbing wall or failing at sourdough. I'll book 30 minutes with each of you over the next two weeks, and mostly I want to hear what's working that I shouldn't touch.
note: New manager of an inherited team: signal listening over change, and don't single out the internal candidate in a group post.

situation: 上周在广州家具展上跟一个做酒店采购的赵经理聊了几句，加了微信，但他应该不记得我了。我们是做实木餐椅的工厂，想发个自我介绍，别像群发广告。
reply: 赵经理您好，我是佛山木森家具的陈晓。上周四在广州家具展3号馆，我们聊过您那边新开的两家酒店餐厅要换椅子。我们厂专做实木餐椅，给酒店做的款主要是好打理、耐磕碰。我自己是木工学徒出身，椅子每一步怎么做的都能讲清楚。您方便的话，我下周把三款酒店常用的样册发您看看？
note: 先帮对方想起你是谁（时间、地点、聊了什么），只讲一件具体的事，最后给一个很小的下一步。

situation: I'm on a panel about small-business websites at a local startup meetup on Thursday Oct 15. The organiser wants a third-person bio under 60 words. I'm a freelance developer in Bristol, six years in, mostly bakeries and cafés.
reply: Lena Novak is a freelance web developer who has spent six years building sites for bakeries, cafés and other small food businesses. Her latest, an online ordering system for three Bristol bakeries, now takes 40% of their orders. She lives in Bristol with a sourdough starter she has kept alive since 2019.
note: A bio still needs one concrete result and one human hook; the hook is what the moderator will use to introduce you.

situation: I'm a freelance UX designer starting a 10-week redesign of a regional credit union's mobile app. Kickoff video call is Thursday Oct 1 with about eight people from their team, and most have never worked with an outside designer. I get about a minute to introduce myself.
reply: Hi everyone, I'm Priya, and I'll be leading the design on the app redesign for the next ten weeks. I've done similar work for two other credit unions, and the thing I care most about is that your members can still find their balance without thinking a year from now. Before design I was a bank teller for three years, so I've heard every complaint about banking apps in person. I'll be asking a lot of questions this week, and none of them are traps. If there's one thing members call you about more than anything, I'd love to hear it today.
note: With a client team wary of outsiders: one relevant credential, one human hook that shows you get their members, and an invitation to talk.

situation: Started yesterday as operations manager at a warehouse, the third one in two years. I posted a short hello in the team WhatsApp and one of the shift leads, Gary, replied 'Another new manager, let's see how long this one lasts 😂'. A few people laughed. How do I answer?
reply: Ha, fair, three managers in two years would make me skeptical too, Gary. I'm planning to stick around long enough to get annoying. Since you've watched all three of us come and go, what's the one thing on the floor you'd fix first? I'm on the night shift Thursday, happy to hear it over a coffee.
note: Take the jab lightly, agree with the true part, and make the skeptic the first person whose opinion you ask for.

situation: 10月1日（木）に中途入社して、営業企画部に配属されます。初日に部署の約30人へ自己紹介メールを送る予定です。堅すぎず、でも失礼のない感じにしたいです。
reply: 営業企画部の皆さま、本日より営業企画部に配属となりました佐藤美穂と申します。前職では食品メーカーで6年間、スーパー向けの販促企画を担当し、売場ごとの数字とにらめっこしてきました。休日は多摩川沿いを走っていて、11月のハーフマラソンに向けて練習中です。早く皆さまのお仕事を知りたいので、ランチなどでお話を聞かせていただけたら嬉しいです。どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
note: 丁寧語は守りつつ、具体的な仕事の話を一つ、人柄が見える話を一つ、最後に声をかけやすい誘いを入れる。

situation: 我刚接手初一（3）班当班主任，教语文。第一次在班级家长群里发自我介绍，群里有45位家长，想简短、亲切一点，也让家长知道怎么找我。
reply: 各位家长好，我是初一（3）班的新班主任林晓，教语文，之前在城东中学带过两届初中生。我比较看重孩子的阅读习惯，每周五会留一篇短文，读完写三句话就行，不求长。课余我喜欢打羽毛球，孩子们估计很快会在操场上看到我。孩子有什么情况，工作日下午4点后可以直接私信我。
note: 老师面对家长：一件具体的教学安排加一个生活小爱好，再说清楚什么时间怎么联系，比一长串资历更让人放心。

situation: 刚跟老公领证，他把我拉进了他们家的家族群，四十多个亲戚，大部分我都没见过。婆婆让我在群里发个自我介绍。我是湖南岳阳人，在长沙教小学英语。
reply: 各位长辈、兄弟姐妹好，我是志强的爱人李晓雯，刚加入咱们这个大家庭，请大家多关照。我是湖南岳阳人，在长沙一所小学教了五年英语。平时喜欢做饭，湘菜比较拿手，辣度可以按各位口味调。国庆回老家，很期待见到大家，也想请哪位长辈给我讲讲志强小时候的趣事。
note: 家族群里语气恭敬一些，但仍要留一个能接话的点，比如拿手菜、想听老公小时候的事。

situation: We just moved into flat 3B in a 12-flat building with our 4-month-old, Isla, and she still cries a lot at night. There's a residents' WhatsApp group. I want to introduce us and give a heads-up about the noise without over-apologising.
reply: Hi everyone, I'm Rosa, and my partner Dev and I moved into 3B on Saturday with our daughter Isla, who's four months old. Fair warning that she's still working out the difference between night and day, so you may hear her through the walls for a while; if it's ever keeping you up, just tell me and we'll move her cot to the back room. I'm a physio, so feel free to ask me about stiff backs after all those stairs. And we'd love to know where the best bakery nearby is.
note: A heads-up with a real fix beats an apology; the human hook is what neighbours will greet you with on the stairs.

situation: My old manager Tom introduced me by email to Dr. Aisha Bello, who runs the clinical data team at St Mary's Hospital. I'm a data analyst in retail hoping to move into healthcare. I need to reply-all and introduce myself.
reply: Thanks, Tom (moving you to bcc). Hi Dr. Bello, I'm Chris Yates, a data analyst at Harlow Retail, where for the last three years I've built the demand forecasts for our 140 stores. I'm hoping to move into healthcare data, and Tom tells me your team's work on outpatient no-shows is some of the best around. Outside work I run the finish funnel at our local parkrun, so I'm used to messy timing data in the rain. Would you have 20 minutes for a call in the next few weeks? Any Tuesday or Thursday afternoon works for me.
note: Replying to an introduction: thank the connector once, move them to bcc, and keep the ask small and easy to schedule.

situation: I've just been elected to the nine-person board of our local food co-op. The first meeting is Tuesday Oct 13 and the chair wants each new member to introduce themselves in about 30 seconds. I'm an accountant and joined the co-op two years ago.
reply: Hi everyone, I'm Hannah Obi, one of the two new board members. By day I'm an accountant for small charities, so I'm happy to be the person who reads the financials closely. I joined the co-op two years ago for the bulk oats and stayed for the Saturday volunteer shifts. Before our next meeting, I'd love 20 minutes with whoever has been preparing the treasurer's reports, so I can learn where the numbers come from.
note: On a board, the concrete thing is the skill you bring, and the invitation is the specific handover you need.

situation: I just joined the Discord for an open-source mapping library I've used at work for two years to draw delivery zones. I'm a backend developer in Lisbon, I want to contribute but have never done open source, and I surf badly at weekends. Posting in #introductions.
reply: Hi all, I'm Inês, a backend developer in Lisbon. I've used the library at work for two years to draw delivery zones, so I've read more of the geometry code than I'd like to admit. I've never contributed to open source and I'd love to start small. Outside work I surf badly every weekend, so I'm used to falling off things. If anyone has a favourite good first issue or a doc page that needs fixing, point me at it.
note: In a contributor community, the invitation is a concrete way in: ask for a first issue, not for attention.

situation: I'm Priya, rejoining my old company on Monday after three years away. I used to be on the analytics team; now I'm a data engineer on the platform team. In between I built data pipelines at a logistics company, and I picked up sourdough baking. About half the Slack channel knows me, half joined after I left.
reply: Hi all, I'm Priya, and some of you will remember me from the analytics team: I'm back after three years away, this time as a data engineer on platform. While I was gone I built data pipelines at a logistics company, so messy shipment data is my happy place. I also picked up sourdough baking, so starter questions welcome. If we haven't met, I'd love 15 minutes to hear what you're working on, and if we have, come tell me what I've missed.
note: A returning hire speaks to both halves of the room: a nod to old colleagues, a proper intro for new ones.
